world.title: Koi no Yokan: Three Evenings
world.tone: Quiet, hopeful, gently funny, and emotionally direct.
world.premise: Rin cannot stand careless, joking Haruto after he ruins her festival schedule, but three evenings with Kaede and Kaito reveal the thoughtful man behind her terrible first impression—and anger gradually becomes love.
world.stylePalette: Dusk sakura pink, sea blue, warm restaurant gold, soft bloom, clean anime linework, expressive faces, cinematic depth of field.

characters.name: Mizuki
characters.descriptor: Young Japanese woman and artist with long wavy dark-teal hair, soft features, and an introspective gaze.
characters.defaultOutfit: Ivory cardigan over a light dress with understated artist-chic accessories.
characters.personality: Observant, creative, kind, and conflict-avoidant; speaks most honestly through unfinished drawings.

characters.name: Rin
characters.descriptor: Young Japanese woman with vivid auburn hair tied back with a ribbon and a direct, expressive gaze.
characters.defaultOutfit: Red off-shoulder top, cream wide-leg trousers, and a small shoulder bag.
characters.personality: Blunt, defensive, funny, and fiercely warm once she decides someone matters.

characters.name: Haruto
characters.descriptor: Young Japanese man with tousled black hair, a calm expression, and relaxed posture.
characters.defaultOutfit: Blue denim jacket over a white shirt with dark trousers.
characters.personality: Patient, perceptive, and difficult to rattle; notices what people leave unsaid.

characters.name: Sora
characters.descriptor: Athletic young Japanese man with short blond hair, bright energy, and an easy grin.
characters.defaultOutfit: White athletic tank, navy shorts, and a blue jacket tied at the waist.
characters.personality: Competitive, kinetic, playful, and incapable of letting a quiet mood stay solemn for long.

characters.name: Reina
characters.descriptor: Elegant young Japanese singer with long wavy black hair and poised stage presence.
characters.defaultOutfit: Fitted red evening dress with red heels.
characters.personality: Confident, perceptive, and theatrical; uses performance as both revelation and armor.

characters.name: Kaito
characters.descriptor: Stylish young Japanese man with dark hair, warm tan skin, and a composed host's smile.
characters.defaultOutfit: Tailored black shirt and black trousers.
characters.personality: Socially perceptive, discreet, and gently mischievous; creates openings for other people to connect.

characters.name: Kaede
characters.descriptor: Athletic young Japanese woman with a long brown ponytail and an upbeat, focused expression.
characters.defaultOutfit: Teal athletic top, dark leggings, and bright teal running shoes.
characters.personality: Practical, energetic, teasing, and supportive without becoming sentimental.

characters.name: Ren
characters.descriptor: Quiet young Japanese man with black hair tied in a small bun and a thoughtful expression.
characters.defaultOutfit: Dark charcoal shirt, olive trousers, and a white towel draped at the neck.
characters.personality: Reserved, trustworthy, and observant; believes privacy should never become isolation.

locations.name: Sakura Plaza
locations.description: A tranquil urban plaza at pink dusk, framed by flowering cherry trees and reflective water.

locations.name: Beach Terrace
locations.description: A breezy seaside terrace at golden hour with open water, pale railings, and long blue shadows.

locations.name: La Dolce Vita
locations.description: An intimate Italian restaurant glowing with amber light, candles, flowers, and polished dark wood.

props.name: Flower Bouquet
props.description: A romantic bouquet wrapped in pale paper.

props.name: Bubble Tea
props.description: A bright takeaway cup of bubble tea.

props.name: Celebration Cake
props.description: A small decorated cake for the final gathering.

props.name: Coffee
props.description: A warm ceramic cup of coffee.

props.name: Film Reel
props.description: A vintage film reel evoking shared memories.

props.name: Mixtape
props.description: A handmade music tape with a personal paper label.

props.name: Ring Box
props.description: A small velvet jewelry box used as a visual misdirect.

props.name: Sports Bottle
props.description: A teal sports bottle used during the beach race.

props.name: Two Tickets
props.description: Two paper tickets representing an invitation into Mizuki's future.

props.name: Umbrella
props.description: A clear rain umbrella for a quiet shared walk.

episodes.title: The Worst First Impression
beats: Rin prepares Kaito's three-night community film festival with Kaede.
Haruto arrives late and spills coffee across Rin's carefully marked schedule.
Rin is furious, but Kaito needs Haruto to stay as the missing volunteer.
Haruto protects Rin's posters and film reel from the rain, earning one reluctant second chance.

scenes.summary: Rin tries to control every detail of opening night while Kaede warns her to breathe.
scenes.audioBed: Delicate piano, rustling blossoms, and the soft bustle of festival setup.

subShots.action: At pink dusk, Rin aligns tickets, lanterns, and a hand-painted screening schedule with exacting care.
subShots.camera: Slow vertical establishing push from Sakura Plaza to Rin's organized table.

subShots.action: Rin checks every line of the schedule while Kaede watches with amused concern.
subShots.camera: Over-shoulder insert on Rin's notes, then a medium two-shot.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: Every lantern... every ticket... every seat has a place. Tonight has to be perfect...

subShots.action: Kaede gently lowers Rin's clipboard and points toward the glowing blossoms.
subShots.camera: Warm close-up on Kaede, then Rin's unimpressed reaction.
subShots.speaker: kaede
subShots.dialogue: Rin... breathe. It's a film night—not a military operation...

scenes.summary: Haruto makes the worst possible entrance and ruins Rin's schedule with coffee.
scenes.audioBed: Playful pizzicato strings interrupt the gentle piano.

subShots.action: Haruto hurries into the plaza carrying a coffee and Kaito's film reel, already late and searching for the projection table.
subShots.camera: Medium tracking entrance with Rin sharp in the background.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: Kaito said the film reel goes over—... oh, no...

subShots.action: Haruto catches his foot on a cable; coffee splashes across Rin's color-coded schedule while he saves the film reel.
subShots.camera: Fast insert montage: cable, tilting cup, coffee spreading over paper.

subShots.action: Rin rises slowly, furious, as Haruto freezes with the empty cup in his hand.
subShots.camera: Low-angle close-up on Rin, reverse to Haruto's alarmed face.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: You spilled coffee... on three weeks of work?! Are you always this careless?!

scenes.summary: Kaede and Kaito force an angry Rin to accept Haruto as her volunteer.
scenes.audioBed: Light comic rhythm under tense festival ambience.

subShots.action: Kaito arrives with Kaede and takes in the soaked schedule, Haruto's guilty posture, and Rin's glare.
subShots.camera: Wide four-character composition, then quick reaction close-ups.
subShots.speaker: kaito
subShots.dialogue: Rin... Haruto came because I asked him. And we're short one volunteer...

subShots.action: Rin folds her arms while Kaede tries not to smile at Haruto's complete defeat.
subShots.camera: Alternating medium close-ups across the group.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: Absolutely not... He is one beverage away from destroying the entire festival...

subShots.action: Haruto sets down the rescued film reel, stops joking, and meets Rin's eyes sincerely.
subShots.camera: Slow push toward Haruto with Rin in soft foreground.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I deserve that... Let me fix what I ruined. No excuses... and no more coffee.

scenes.summary: Haruto protects Rin's work from sudden rain and earns a reluctant second chance.
scenes.audioBed: Rain joins warm piano as the comic tension softens.

subShots.action: Rain suddenly sweeps across the plaza; Haruto opens the umbrella over Rin's posters and the film reel instead of himself.
subShots.camera: Wide rain reveal, then close-up on the protected artwork.

subShots.action: Soaked, Haruto holds the umbrella steady while Kaito and Kaede carry the equipment to shelter.
subShots.camera: Intimate two-shot of Rin and Haruto beneath the umbrella edge.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: You protected the posters... before yourself? I thought you didn't notice anything...

subShots.action: Haruto smiles carefully; Rin hands him a dry towel without softening her expression.
subShots.camera: Close-up on the towel changing hands, then their held eye contact.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: One shift... one. I still don't like you—so don't make me regret this...

episodes.title: When the Tide Turns
beats: Kaito sends Rin and Haruto across Beach Terrace with the festival ticket box.
A gust scatters the tickets, and the pair save them by working together.
Haruto admits that he jokes when nervous; Rin admits why carelessness makes her angry.
Kaede reveals that Haruto quietly repaired Rin's coffee-damaged schedule.
At sunset, Rin realizes she no longer dislikes the man she expected to hate.

scenes.summary: Kaede and Kaito deliberately assign the tense pair another job together.
scenes.audioBed: Bright acoustic rhythm over surf, wind, and distant festival chatter.

subShots.action: At Beach Terrace, Kaito places a box of paper tickets between Rin and Haruto while Kaede blocks Rin's escape route.
subShots.camera: Wide seaside establishing shot resolving into a four-person group.
subShots.speaker: kaito
subShots.dialogue: The screening starts in one hour... and this ticket box belongs at the far terrace...

subShots.action: Rin points toward every other volunteer; Kaede places the box firmly into Rin's hands.
subShots.camera: Fast alternating close-ups with playful timing.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: Send anyone else... literally anyone. Preferably someone who fears hot beverages...

subShots.action: Haruto raises both empty hands and walks beside Rin while Kaito and Kaede exchange a knowing glance.
subShots.camera: Rear tracking shot toward the far terrace.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I promise... no drinks within ten meters of the schedule. Or you...

scenes.summary: Wind scatters the tickets, forcing Rin and Haruto into frantic teamwork.
scenes.audioBed: Quick playful percussion rises over a strong seaside gust.

subShots.action: A sudden gust tears the lid free and sends paper tickets spinning across the terrace.
subShots.camera: Whip-pan from the open box to tickets filling the vertical frame.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: Haruto... the tickets!! Please tell me this is not happening again?!

subShots.action: Haruto dives to pin the box at the railing while Rin gathers tickets against the wind.
subShots.camera: Low side-tracking action shot with the sea beyond the railing.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I've got the box... You take the railing. And, Rin—don't lean too far!

subShots.action: They capture the final ticket together, collide shoulder-first, and laugh before either can stop it.
subShots.camera: Close two-shot, briefly suspended in surprised eye contact.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: That was reckless... and surprisingly useful. Do not look so proud...

scenes.summary: A quiet conversation replaces Rin's assumptions with understanding.
scenes.audioBed: The percussion fades into reflective guitar and steady surf.

subShots.action: Rin and Haruto sit on the terrace steps with the rescued ticket box safely between them.
subShots.camera: Calm profile two-shot against the open water.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I joke when I'm nervous... which, around you, is apparently all the time...

subShots.action: Rin studies him, then smooths the bent edge of a ticket instead of looking directly at him.
subShots.camera: Close-up on Rin's hands, then a gentle push to her face.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: I get angry when people don't take me seriously... I've had too much practice with that...

subShots.action: Haruto's smile fades into simple sincerity; Rin finally looks at him.
subShots.camera: Alternating close-ups in soft sea light.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I take you seriously... even when you're terrifying. Maybe especially then...

scenes.summary: Kaede and Kaito expose the care Haruto tried to keep private.
scenes.audioBed: Warm piano returns with a light, teasing rhythm.

subShots.action: Kaede catches Rin smiling at Haruto from across the terrace and nudges Kaito.
subShots.camera: Kaede foreground close-up with Rin and Haruto defocused behind her.
subShots.speaker: kaede
subShots.dialogue: You smiled at him... voluntarily. Should I call a doctor—or plan a wedding?!

subShots.action: Rin denies it while Kaito hands her the restored, carefully rewritten festival schedule.
subShots.camera: Medium three-shot, then close-up on the repaired pages.
subShots.speaker: kaito
subShots.dialogue: Haruto stayed up repairing every page... He made me promise not to tell you...

subShots.action: Rin looks toward Haruto, who is helping another volunteer and unaware she knows.
subShots.camera: Slow rack focus from Rin's softened expression to Haruto in the distance.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: He... did all of this? And he didn't want the credit...

scenes.summary: At sunset, Rin admits she no longer hates Haruto and feels the first unmistakable spark.
scenes.audioBed: Romantic piano and strings rise gently beneath the evening surf.

subShots.action: Rin finds Haruto at the railing and holds up the repaired schedule as Kaito and Kaede pack equipment in the distance.
subShots.camera: Sunset medium two-shot with their friends visible behind them.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: You remembered every note... even the ridiculous color system...

subShots.action: Haruto leans beside her, close enough that their shoulders touch, but lets Rin choose whether to move away.
subShots.camera: Intimate profile close-up with amber rim light.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I remember what matters to you... Apparently, that's becoming a very long list...

subShots.action: Rin stays beside him, hiding a smile as the first terrace lights turn on.
subShots.camera: Close-up on Rin's smile, then a slow pull back over the sea.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: I don't hate you... as much. Do not make that face—it's a major promotion...

episodes.title: Before the Lights Go Out
beats: At La Dolce Vita, Kaede confronts Rin about watching the door for Haruto.
Kaito tells Haruto to stop hiding his feelings behind jokes.
Rin becomes angry when Haruto plans to leave without asking what she wants.
Rin admits that reluctant respect became love, and Haruto answers clearly.
Kaede and Kaito give the new couple two tickets for their first real date.

scenes.summary: Kaede makes Rin confront why she keeps watching the restaurant door.
scenes.audioBed: Warm restaurant ambience under playful piano.

subShots.action: At the candlelit wrap dinner, Rin straightens Haruto's empty place setting for the third time.
subShots.camera: Insert on the place setting, then reveal Kaede watching her.

subShots.action: Kaede leans across the table as Rin glances toward the entrance again.
subShots.camera: Tight two-shot with warm candle bokeh.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: I am not in love with Haruto... I am evaluating a previously disappointing volunteer...

subShots.action: Kaede counts Rin's repeated door checks on her fingers and grins.
subShots.camera: Playful close-up on Kaede, then Rin's flustered reaction.
subShots.speaker: kaede
subShots.dialogue: Of course... That's why you've checked the door nine times. Very professional...

scenes.summary: Kaito challenges Haruto to stop assuming Rin could never return his feelings.
scenes.audioBed: Muted strings and soft room ambience.

subShots.action: Near the restaurant entrance, Haruto hesitates with a bouquet while Kaito blocks his quiet retreat.
subShots.camera: Medium two-shot with the dining room glowing behind them.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: She tolerated me yesterday... I should retire undefeated before I ruin the record...

subShots.action: Kaito points toward the seat Rin saved beside her and takes Haruto's coat.
subShots.camera: Over-shoulder from Haruto toward Rin's table.
subShots.speaker: kaito
subShots.dialogue: She saved you the seat beside her... That is not tolerance, Haruto...

subShots.action: Haruto grips the bouquet, visibly more nervous than he was during any festival disaster.
subShots.camera: Close-up on Haruto as Kaito lowers his voice.
subShots.speaker: kaito
subShots.dialogue: Stop hiding behind the joke... Stay long enough to hear what she actually wants...

scenes.summary: Haruto's plan to leave reawakens Rin's anger for a completely different reason.
scenes.audioBed: Piano turns intimate and uncertain beneath the quiet room.

subShots.action: Haruto gives Rin the bouquet and a framed fragment of the coffee-stained original schedule.
subShots.camera: Close-up on the gifts, then Rin's surprised expression.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I couldn't erase the first night... so I saved the part where everything changed...

subShots.action: Haruto admits he planned to leave after dinner; Rin's tenderness flashes back into anger as Kaede and Kaito step away.
subShots.camera: Alternating close-ups, with friends receding into soft background.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: I thought I'd give you this... then get out of your way. You deserve a peaceful ending...

subShots.action: Rin catches Haruto by the sleeve before he can move and forces him to face her.
subShots.camera: Close-up on Rin's hand, then a charged two-shot.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: You're leaving... without even asking what I want?! Have you learned nothing from me?!

scenes.summary: Rin admits that anger became respect, longing, and finally love.
scenes.audioBed: Restaurant ambience falls away into romantic piano and swelling strings.

subShots.action: Rin sets down the frame and gathers the courage to speak without using anger as armor.
subShots.camera: Slow push into Rin's candlelit close-up.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: At first... I really did not like you. You were late, loud... and you covered my life in coffee...

subShots.action: Haruto starts to answer, but Rin holds up one finger and steps closer.
subShots.camera: Intimate two-shot, shallow depth of field.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: Don't interrupt... Then you stayed. You listened... you remembered. And somewhere between being furious... and waiting for you to arrive... I fell in love with you.

subShots.action: Haruto takes Rin's hand carefully, waiting until she closes her fingers around his.
subShots.camera: Close-up on joined hands, then Haruto's open expression.
subShots.speaker: haruto
subShots.dialogue: Rin... I fell for you that first night. And now... I love you. Clearly, completely... no joke.

scenes.summary: Kaede and Kaito celebrate the new couple and send them toward their first real date.
scenes.audioBed: The full hopeful theme rises toward a clean romantic finish.

subShots.action: Rin looks Haruto directly in the eyes, still holding his hand as the restaurant lights glow around them.
subShots.camera: Tight romantic two-shot.
subShots.speaker: rin
subShots.dialogue: Good... because I love you too. And you are still never carrying my coffee...

subShots.action: Kaede and Kaito return with two movie tickets and place them beside the bouquet.
subShots.camera: Overhead insert on two tickets, then cheerful four-person group shot.
subShots.speaker: kaito
subShots.dialogue: Two tickets... no volunteer duties attached. Consider it your first official date...

subShots.action: Rin pulls Haruto into a quick kiss; Kaede cheers while Kaito turns the restaurant lights into a sparkling final frame.
subShots.camera: Romantic close-up, then slow pull back through warm golden light.
subShots.speaker: kaede
subShots.dialogue: Finally!! Now, please... try not to schedule every minute of falling in love!
